description: This file defines a static class RuntimeTypeNameRewriter used for rewriting and transforming TypeSpec graphs, including handling generic types, named types, array types, pointers, references, and tuple types. It provides mechanisms for customizing type rewriting via delegates, with detailed internal logic for traversal and modification of type graphs.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameRewriter
classes.description: A static utility class for rewriting TypeSpec graphs, including internal handling for various specific TypeSpec kinds.

methods.name: Rewrite
methods.description: Rewrites a TypeSpec using a provided rewriter delegate and optional compound alias resolver, updating the user state as needed.
